No option can be put forward yet because the model could not assess your “monthly churn < 4%” limit.

- The price comparison held up under the changes tested, but that is not a check that any option reaches £20k MRR or stays below 4% churn.
- The churn limit is unscored because churn is modelled as a calculated result rather than a directly comparable reading. The £20k target’s frame and the goal direction are also unspecified in the analysis.
- The ordering is most sensitive to the Pro subscriber count, which is an Olumi estimate rather than user evidence; investigation priority is not established from this alone.
